title: Source Session Handoff — initiation wire (v1.0)
description: Public-safe initiation of one source-session handoff under profile oauth2-authorization-code-pkce-s256-v1. A valid initiation does not authenticate identity and does not grant permission, role, membership, runtime admission, or access. Browser-supplied copies of this object are not trusted.

profile.description: Selects the frozen OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code profile with PKCE S256 only.

handoff_ref.description: Identity of this handoff attempt. Replay uses exact string equality.

issuer.description: Issuer identifier compared by exact string equality. This contract does not fetch issuer metadata.

receiver_ref.description: Intended receiving party. Presence does not create a receiver role or permission.

client_ref.description: Registered client binding for the receiving party. Presence does not grant access.

destination_uri.description: Exact registered redirect URI for this handoff.

transaction_ref.description: Opaque browser-bound transaction correlation. The raw browser state value is not carried.

nonce_ref.description: Opaque reference to the browser-bound nonce correlation. The raw nonce value is not carried.

requested_record_scope_refs.description: Record scopes requested for this handoff. Empty, duplicate, and wildcard values are forbidden. Presence does not grant receiver access.

expires_at.description: End of the authorization-code window. Conformance requires a strictly positive duration no greater than 60 seconds.

correlation_ref.description: Correlation shared by the initiation, authenticated context, and failure for this attempt.
